#### ✅ Formal Requirement
The system **shall** distribute regulated **5 V**, **12 V**, and **3.3 V** power rails derived from a **6S Li-Ion** battery source via the **TI LM51231** PMIC to the **Jetson Orin NX**, **STM32H753** flight controller, **FLIR Boson 640**, **Sony IMX477**, **Microhard pDDL** modem, and **Here+ RTK** GPS.

#### 🔍 Assumptions (if any)
- The input voltage range of the **TI LM51231** PMIC is compatible with the nominal and operational voltage range of a fully charged to depleted **6S Li-Ion** battery pack (approx. **25.2 V** to **22.2 V**).
- The phrase "distributes" implies that the system provides stable, regulated power meeting the specific current and ripple requirements of each listed subsystem under normal operating conditions.
explanation: This power requirement mandates measurable hardware parameters (battery, power, voltage).
text_original: Power from 6S Li-Ion battery → TI LM51231 PMIC → distributes 5V/12V/3.3V to: • Jetson Orin NX (main compute) • STM32H753 flight controller • FLIR Boson 640 (thermal) • Sony IMX477 (EO) • Microhard pDDL modem • Here+ RTK GPS
